title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-05-03
lineage: PCM (Sony SL-HF66) > Sony PCM-601ESD (analog outs) >Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) > KORG AudioGate 4 >Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: (Stage) Sony Stereo Mic > Master Reel > PCM

ai_review.summary: Stage‑side stereo mic capture delivers killer sound with standout performances of He Was a Friend of Mine and The Other One.
ai_review.review: The audience recording, made with a stereo microphone just off the stage, provides crisp, immersive audio that most listeners describe as "killer sound." The show shines on He Was a Friend of Mine and The Other One, though Jerry’s guitar and the vocals sit a little low in the mix. Overall the tape is judged excellent.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewer gave 5 stars, praising both performance and sound; limited data (single review) lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo mic off‑stage yields clear, immersive sound; slight mix imbalance with Jerry's guitar and vocals a bit low.

standout_songs: He Was a Friend of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on flow; reviewers focus on individual song performances.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar is noted as slightly low in the mix but performance praised.
